mechanism_name: foreign-print overshoot-magnitude-gated fade on non-reporting pairs (all four blocs)
causal_claim_one_sentence: When a GB, CA, AU or NZ CPI print jolts a non-reporting USD pair by more than one typical trading day's move — a displacement that pair-local fundamentals do not require and that event-locked liquidity providers must absorb into inventory — the providers are forced to shed that inventory over the following days and the overshoot decays, so fading the post-window jump (selling an up-jolt, buying a down-jolt) at the funded 16:00-NY decision earns the decay; the mechanism must fail if the jolt is informed common-USD-factor repricing that persists rather than inventory overshoot.
falsification_rule: The claim is proven wrong if any of: (a) theta-gated fade positions show nonpositive financing-adjusted expectancy at stress tier 2.0 (rule 1); (b) PF < 1.10 (rule 2) or populated positive folds < 2 of 3 (rule 3); (c) the sham-calendar placebo reproduces the anchor's expectancy under rule-10 control coherence (meaning fat-tailed FX days carry the same decaying-overshoot structure with or without a real print, so the foreign-print calendar carries no information); (d) pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY forbidden exposure schedule measured at D2, specifically including V6 FXFV6-A6-P2 USD PC1-concentration-gated cross-pair reversal.
control_class: sham-calendar placebo (mandatory on lane 1): every qualifying (economy, event_date) is shifted +7 calendar days to the SAME WEEKDAY; the shifted clock inherits the identical reaction-window length, theta gate, funded-decision offset and k-hold semantics; the overshoot and hold returns are recomputed from the SAME staged price bytes at the shifted dates; shifted clocks whose windows overlap a true same-economy event date or the 2 calendar days bracketing one are dropped fail-closed; V6's sham-NEGATIVE on the same control class is the recorded proof the control discriminates.
expected_failure_mode: The family is willing to lose to three named alternatives: (i) coverage starvation — the theta gate selects a subset of the 1077 clocks and if |o|>=theta fires too rarely the arms go vacuous or rule-3 fold population fails (COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT is an accepted death, not a tuning target); (ii) persistence — the jolt is a durable common-USD repricing, the fade fights the drift and rule-1 kills it (note this proposal's sign logic is deliberately OPPOSITE to FXFV7-A4-P1 on the same event dates, so the family loses at most one of the two, never both to the same sign error); (iii) control-identifiability — if sham dates generate similar overshoot-decay payoffs, CONTROL_REPRODUCED_MECHANISM ends the proposal. USD-leg correlation across the six same-date positions again exposes rules 4 and 9, accepted.

anchor.spec: for each funded clock with |o| >= 1.0: position = -sign(r_W) on the non-reporting pair, entered at the funded 16:00-NY instant, held k=3 trading days; clocks with |o| < 1.0 evaluate to flat

neighbour.spec: SAME mechanism, SAME feature, SAME clocks, SAME k=3; stricter gate theta = 2.0 (only jolts exceeding two typical daily moves are faded — tests whether the decay effect concentrates in extreme overshoots; distinct conditioning parameter, not a distinct mechanism)

control.spec: sham-calendar placebo at anchor parameters (theta=1.0, k=3): +7 calendar-day matched-weekday shift of every qualifying event date, identical windows/gates/offsets/holds, recomputed on the same staged price bytes, fail-closed dedupe vs true event dates

costs: P3 freeze inherited verbatim: 1.5 bps/side x {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}; tier 2.0 PRIMARY (6.0 bps round trip); break-even bps gate vs 1.5 floor (rule 5)

folds.rule: 3 folds = thirds of S0 2018-04-04..2025-07-24 by decision_date; calendar-third boundaries 2020-09-09 and 2023-02-16; gate: >=2 of 3 folds positive-populated (rule 3)
folds.non_vacuity: every arm evaluates the same 1077 funded clocks by construction (decision evaluations per fold per arm = 114/480/483, strictly positive); the theta gate selects a subset of evaluations into positions and the gated count is measured at execution, never tuned post hoc — gate starvation is a declared death (COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT), not a parameter-search space; the control arm can only shrink by explicit fail-closed dedupe
folds.honest_total: 1077 decision evaluations per arm, 3231 across the three arms; gated positions <= evaluations; no PnL is computed at D1

gates_referenced: p3_invariants_freeze_v7.json baseline_invariants.rule_order 1-10 verbatim (expectancy mechanical reject at tier 2.0; PF>=1.10; folds>=2/3; pair concentration<=0.40; break-even<=1.5bps floor; dual-book sign non-inversion; LOPO all subsets; tier-2.0 stress margin; USD-drift diagnostic; mechanism sanity with MANDATORY sham-calendar), plus ancestry veto |rho|<=0.20 pooled vs all forbidden inventory including V6 FXFV6-A4-P1 and FXFV6-A6-P2

ancestry_distinctness.vs_V6_FXFV6-A6-P2: that ancestor was gated on a rolling USD PC1 CONCENTRATION factor (regime variable, not event-locked) and reversed cross pairs on regime days; this proposal is gated on the EVENT-LOCKED magnitude of a foreign print's spillover into a specific non-reporting pair, conditioned only on the 1077 P2 clocks, with sign taken pair-locally from the jolt itself; exposure schedules differ (print-locked decision dates vs regime days) and D2 measures pooled |rho|<=0.20 as the binding authority
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V6_FXFV6-A4-P1: no own-pair conditioning anywhere (reporting pairs excluded per clock); and the sign logic is REVERSION of a pair-local overshoot, not continuation of a release-signed drift
ancestry_distinctness.vs_FXFV7-A4-P1: distinct mechanism by construction: P1 trades WITH sign(r_W) unconditionally (continuation); P2 trades AGAINST sign(r_W) conditionally on |o|>=theta (magnitude-gated fade); conditioning feature (sign vs magnitude), trade direction (with vs against), neighbour axis (hold k vs gate theta) and economy scope (GB+CA vs all four blocs) all differ — not parameter twins, not relabelled versions
ancestry_distinctness.vs_V5_V4_V3R_V1_V2: no position-avoidance, no carry/rate-differential input, no session-of-day structure; single frozen 16:00-NY decision clock

no_new_data: no FRED, no key-requiring source, no signup; conditioning restricted to the published P2 clocks and the staged price snapshot
